This spiritual concept emphasizes the importance of realizing one's oneness with God through self-effacement, humility, and devotion. The name Rubiya, with its connection to the precious ruby and its inherent value, serves as a reminder of the spiritual value and worth of the individual as a creation and beloved of God. Thus, the name is a constant reminder of the importance of seeking spiritual cultivation and a deepening connection with the Divine.
